subject.title: [Bug]: context-overflow-midturn-precheck estimator over-counts ~2.3-2.6x vs billed usage (tool-result chars at 2 chars/token over the untruncated transcript)

question: Which open fix shape should become the canonical landing path for this mid-turn estimator bug?
rationale: Multiple open PRs target this issue with different scopes, and maintainer feedback on the strongest projection-layer PR asks for split or tighter proof before merge.

options.title: Tighten the scoped projection fix
options.body: Prefer a branch that proves mid-turn projection alignment against the real aggregate cap and keeps any global estimator relaxation separately justified.

options.title: Land a constant-only mitigation
options.body: Accept a narrower ratio change if maintainers decide the reporter's scenario is fully explained by token density and projection alignment can remain follow-up work.

options.title: Pause all candidates
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for a new exact-head fix if the current overlapping branches are not worth adopting.

recommendation.title: Tighten the scoped projection fix
recommendation.body: Prefer a branch that proves mid-turn projection alignment against the real aggregate cap and keeps any global estimator relaxation separately justified.

likelyOwner.reason: He is both a recent source contributor on the affected lines and the maintainer who already gave concrete fix-shape feedback on the strongest candidate PR.
